ei.title: The Hidden Labor in a Computerized Era
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to complete our own reservations and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.

❌ ④ to bag: be expected to bag 정상

❌ ③ 더 적은 시간을 갖는 현실: 약속과 반대인 현실
❌ ④ 직원이 대신 처리: 본문과 무관
det.tip: this way = 앞에서 약속된 (기계가 고된 일 맡는) 방식

questions.passage: The promise of a computerized society, we were told, was that it would pass to machines all of the repetitive drudgery of work, allowing us humans to pursue higher purposes and to have more leisure time. It didn't work out this way. Instead of more time, most of us have less. Companies large and small have off-loaded work onto the backs of consumers. Things that used to be done for us, as part of the value-added service of working with a company, we are now expected to do ourselves. With air travel, we're now expected to __________ and check-in, jobs that used to be done by airline employees or travel agents. At the grocery store, we're expected to bag our own groceries and, in some supermarkets, to scan our own purchases.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 complete our own reservations(예약을 직접 완수하다)가 적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① cancel the extra service fees(추가 수수료를 취소하다): 본문 근거 없음
❌ ② call an experienced travel agent(여행사에 전화하다): 예전에 대행하던 대상이라 반대
✅ ③ complete our own reservations(예약을 직접 완수하다): 항공 여행에서 예약과 체크인을 '직접 완수'하도록 기대된다 ← 정답
❌ ④ upgrade our seats for free(좌석을 무료 업그레이드): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: expected to complete our own reservations and check-in

det.korean: we are now expected to do ourselves
det.analysis:

[조건 검증] we(1) are(2) now(3) expected(4) to(5) do(6) ourselves(7) = 7단어 ✅
